clear_malaria.label: 1. Clear malaria (Kumba, RDT positive)
clear_malaria.story: Adult from Kumba, 2 days of fever with chills. The RDT came back positive.

ambiguous.label: 2. Suspected malaria, no test yet (Yaounde)
ambiguous.story: Fever for 3 days with headache. No RDT done yet.

not_malaria.label: 3. Probably not malaria (Douala, RDT negative, cough)
not_malaria.story: Mild fever and cough for 2 days. RDT negative.

danger_signs.label: 4. Danger signs (Buea, child, vomiting everything)
danger_signs.story: Child of 4 with high fever who vomits everything and is very drowsy.

follow_up.label: 5. Fever is back after treatment (Kumba, run case 1 first)
follow_up.story: Same Kumba patient, fever again a few days after being treated. H-MEM remembers the treatment.
